objective: Expose a deterministic readable Lean denotation of admitted finalized VSCore 0.3 source, with kernel-checked universal equality to its unchanged exact compiled entries, as optional authoring support.

execution_boundary.live_run_effect: None. This design is not implemented, qualified, or supplied to the frozen live run.
execution_boundary.provenance: Generic current APIs and read-only API review. No retained task source, proof, case, carrier, expected output, or result is an input. Observed generic normalization difficulties motivate readability; no task candidate is produced.
execution_boundary.inspection_note: An initial unscoped rg --files enumerated retained artifact paths, without opening retained contents. Subsequent reads were named generic APIs and v1 design only. No retained task/corpus/stage contents, model/build/Lean/task tooling, or source edits occurred.

invariants.requirement: Preserve canonical source bytes, profile, language, semantics, accepted nominal identities and adapter identity. The readable view is not a new delivered endpoint or runtime.

Keep existing source_fn definitions, universal Refines inventory, EdgeProp meaning, per-ID transfer statements and admitted raw coverage. Preserve source-only facet treatment and refinement of required extras.

Generate readable bodies only from source, signatures, exact nominal/enumeration registries and renderer identity. Do not inspect accepted function bodies, accepted guarantee formulas, task examples, expected outputs, previous proofs, or model suggestions.
Every exposed equality quantifies over all intrinsic environments or all accepted argument values; finite execution examples cannot establish correspondence.

Kernel replay must check the exact correspondence theorem type, definitions, dependency identity and transitive axioms. No new axiom allowance, sorry, native_decide, extern, implemented_by, unsafe or partial code.
Keep the compiler side intact. Cast erasure, similar types, pretty output, renderer determinism or source admission alone cannot establish readable equality.
Readable support failure is not a failure of the existing source language capability. Its absence must leave the unchanged standard authoring path and all proof obligations available.
Bind optional support explicitly. Helpers outside EdgeProp's dependency closure are not automatically covered by the current proposition hash.

types: acyclic nominal Record with exact ordered fields; arbitrary finite nesting of supported types

bin_ops.eq: Exact typed structural equality via the same denoteDecidableEq carrier; Bool result.
bin_ops.add_sub_mul: Nat and Int only; Nat subtraction is saturating, Int subtraction is signed.
bin_ops.lt_le: Nat, Int and String only; emit Bool-valued decide of the same pinned Lean comparison.
bin_ops.and_or: Bool only; preserve compiler Bool operations without interpreting them as propositions.

primitive_semantics.intFdiv: The exact pinned Lean Int.fdiv operation, including zero and negative divisors.
primitive_semantics.natToInt_intToNat: Int.ofNat and Int.toNat exactly; no bounded machine arithmetic.
primitive_semantics.string: String.ofList of admitted Unicode scalar codepoints via Char.ofNat; no ASCII, byte, UTF-16 or locale reinterpretation.
primitive_semantics.listGet: The same total Option-producing List.get?Internal call used by the compiler.
primitive_semantics.listSort: The compiler's mergeSort and ascending decide(a <= b) comparator for admitted Nat, Int or String elements.
primitive_semantics.listUnique: The same first-occurrence eraseDups behavior and admitted primitive carriers.
primitive_semantics.listFold: List.foldl with the exact accumulator/item positions and surrounding immutable captures.
primitive_semantics.natFold: Nat.rec with the compiler's exact initial state, index and accumulator positions; no execution fuel.
primitive_semantics.remaining_list_ops: Pinned Lean List.range, length, append, reverse, map, filter and sum, exactly as selected by compileExpr.

closed_coverage.helper_coverage: Acyclic source helpers over supported types and constructors, including helpers called inside list/natural folds and map/filter bodies. Named definitions in stable dependency order preserve sharing; calls use declaration-order arguments.
excluded_first_milestone: variant / matchVariant and types depending on them
any future or unrecognized source constructor
any carrier the existing bridge cannot map through exact adapters
recursive/cyclic nominal declarations or helpers, which existing admission already rejects
closed_coverage.unsupported_rule: Determine support recursively before rendering. Any unsupported constructor, type or required helper makes that entry's view UNSUPPORTED with all missing reasons. Never emit a partial view or replace a missing operation with a constant/default. This does not change the base backend's existing admission.
closed_coverage.all_or_nothing: One source view covers every actual compiled helper and every entry, including unused helpers. Any unsupported constructor/type anywhere in the source/helper/declaration inventory makes the whole optional view unavailable. No partial CHECKED inventory.

existing_api_findings: vscore3_checker.run_build builds the library, accepted module, generated goal and optional proof in one isolated build; a goal compile failure currently raises blocking UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY. Optional append-only support must not be spliced into that existing unqualified path.

vscore3_checker._audit checks kernel import/replay, module inventory, proof safety/edge axioms, expected goal statements, accepted transfer dependencies and source reification. It does not establish exhaustive unused optional-support axiom/type/body inventory.
vscore3_target.proposition_hash hashes the semantic closure from EdgeProp. Support declarations outside that closure are not bound by it.

exprjson.decl_hash hashes theorem type, not proof body. VeriSlopKernel.constToJson exports theorem value_constants, not proof expression; exact support proof-body export or kernel-produced canonical digest is missing machinery.

No verify_accepted function exists in inspected current generic Python APIs. The conceptual accepted verification path is vscore3_checker.verify_published, also reached through prepare.verify_preparation and vscore3_closure._selected_evidence. Contract acceptance replay remains import_contract.

compileFunction runs a body checked under params.reverse by applying envReverse params to declared-order arguments. Helpers in checkedProgram.helpers are compiled in compileHelperPass/compileHelpers scheduler order, which can differ from declaration order.

compileFunction_signature and checkedEntry_signature already tie entry signatures to source. No checkedHelper_signature/provenance or RunEquals API exists yet. Exact helper lookup is checkedProgram.helpers.find? (fun h => h.id == id).

source_only_rendering.route: Deterministic typed structural source renderer. Normalization is a separate later prototype.
pure_inputs: exact accepted enum registry and accepted carrier type/constructor signatures needed to validate those layouts
excluded_inputs: accepted reference function bodies or their proof terms
model output except finalized source bytes
source_only_rendering.source_key: canonical hash of source bytes plus body-independent projection of exact source/enum/nominal registry and renderer/coverage/recipe hashes. Accepted IR/certificate/reference-body/guarantee hashes do not enter the readable body or typed IR.
source_only_rendering.binding_key: Separate hash of source_key, full profile/accepted IR/certificate/relation/adapter/current goal/policy/toolchain identities. Changing accepted bodies can change binding records while the source-only block remains byte-identical.

Enriched goal appends the identical block after the complete byte-identical base goal text, then adds correspondence/wrappers in namespace VeriSlopBridgeGoal.Readable. All source-only names use stable source-index ids; helper definitions emit in actual admitted helper compilation order, with source-index tie identities; no helper inlining.

explicit_function_interfaces.shapes: For each entry/helper f, P_f=[tau_0,...,tau_n-1] in declared parameter order and R_f its exact resolved result. Both are literal Shape aliases in the source-only block, independently checked against actual compiler fields.
explicit_function_interfaces.env_signature: def readable_run_f (args : VSCore3.Env P_f) : VSCore3.Denote R_f := readable_body_f (VSCore3.envReverse P_f args). readable_body_f faces Env P_f.reverse and uses the original source de Bruijn stack.
explicit_function_interfaces.named_signature: def readable_named_f (p__0 : Denote tau_0) ... (p__n-1 : Denote tau_n-1) : Denote R_f := readable_run_f (p__0,(p__1,...,(p__n-1,()))). Zero arguments use Env [] = Unit and ().
explicit_function_interfaces.named_conversion_law: forall declared-order named arguments, readable_named_f args = readable_run_f their exact declared-order Env tuple; exact universal theorem or definitional equality audited. Named declarations may preserve names only for display; no parameter permutation.

source_binders.entry_helper_body: params.reverse; index 0 is last declared parameter
source_binders.listFold_step: item :: accumulator :: outer; host lambda accumulator then item
source_binders.natFold_step: accumulator :: Nat-index :: outer; host Nat.rec lambda index then accumulator

explicit_function_interfaces.helper_captures: Helpers are closed declared functions; captures in map/fold/let remain immutable outer lexical Env values. A helper receives captures only through its explicit source actual arguments; never add a hidden capture or reorder a parameter.

compiled_inventory_and_laws.inventory: Every source entry and helper, including unused helpers, maps one-to-one to an actual checkedProgram entry/helper. Inventory records source role/id/index/hash, actual compiled index, exact success-context hash, params/result shape hashes, compiled alias, readable Env/named defs, lookup/signature/RunEquals theorem names and exact types. Unknown, duplicate, missing, extra or different same-signature helper is rejected.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.entry_lookup: forall source entry f, VSCore3.findEntry checkedProgram f.id = some exact_entry_f; current find_<symbol> is reused where applicable. Exact_entry_f signature is checked against source resolution under checkedProgram.declarations and declared-order fields.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.helper_lookup: (checkedProgram.helpers.find? (fun h => h.id == f.id)) = some exact_helper_f. The alias may repackage explicit fields as current entry aliases do, but this equality ties run to the actual compiled helper, never to a fresh readable function or recompiled final context.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.helper_provenance: Record actual compileHelperPass/compileHelpers pass equations, ordered pending and successful helper-prefix contexts, and the exact compileFunction success equation at the pass admitting f. Kernel prove f.id, resolved declared params/result, and actual lookup. Do not assume compileFunction under final helper context reproduces an originally captured prefix.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.missing_generic_laws: Either prove reusable helper pass/member/source/signature provenance lemmas, or emit bounded closed pass/lookup/signature equations checked by pinned kernel reduction. The generic theorem interfaces are fixed before code; no task-specific facts enter them.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.RunEquals_proposed_definition: def RunEquals (c : VSCore3.CompiledFunction) (P : List VSCore3.Shape) (R : VSCore3.Shape) (r : VSCore3.Env P → VSCore3.Denote R) : Prop := ∃ hp : c.params = P, ∃ hr : c.result = R, ∀ args : VSCore3.Env P, hr ▸ c.run (hp.symm ▸ args) = r args
compiled_inventory_and_laws.RunEquals_law: For every exact actual compiled entry/helper, RunEquals exact_f P_f R_f readable_run_f. The equality proofs hp/hr and every Env binder are mandatory. For a repackage with canonical fields this reduces to forall args, exact_f.run args=readable_run_f args. Narrowed domains, missing binders, equality to itself, True or a different function are rejected.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.accepted_wrapper: For each exact accepted symbol binding, readable_fn_symbol uses its original arg adapters .to, declared-order tuple, readable_run_f and original result adapter .inv. forall accepted args, unchanged source_fn_symbol args=readable_fn_symbol args.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.raw_leg: For every original bound symbol, forall accepted args, exact VSCore3.evalEntry profile rawProgram exact-entry-id encoded-args = Except.ok(result_adapter.encode(readable_fn_symbol args)). Derive by existing raw_eval_* or evalEntry_encoded plus run/wrapper equality. Original InputsCover/raw laws and malformed-raw exclusion are unchanged.
compiled_inventory_and_laws.independent_base_obligations: The view never proves accepted reference behavior. Universal Refines, required extras, EdgeProp, accepted per-ID transfer dependencies, raw coverage and source-only facet treatment remain exactly the base inventory.

finite_proof_generation_recipe: 1. Admit and kernel replay the unchanged base; reify exact source/registry/checked source metadata. Calculate closed view coverage/budgets before output. Python typing/IR remain untrusted.

2. Reproduce actual closed declaration resolution and helper scheduling. Generate exact lookup/signature and compile-success equations with original fuel (exprBudget body+1, decremented by recursive compileExpr), source contexts and typed casts. These compiler-administration equations are closed metadata and may use kernel reduction/rfl or pinned decide +kernel where decidable; never native_decide.

3. Process each source expression in stable postorder. Introduce exact Gamma/shape and a compiler-result shell bound by its compile-success equation; generate its universal pointwise equality to the corresponding readable node. Use only the matrix rule for that constructor, child laws and already admitted helper laws; do not replace the compiler body with the readable body as an assumed witness.

4. Use reviewed castCompiled/castPacked/shape equality/environment tuple and projection transport laws. Branches use cases on the runtime constructor and child pointwise IHs. map/filter/foldl/Nat.rec use reviewed pointwise congruence at all runtime inputs; no unbounded evaluation or broad global cbv/simp. Record pack/project use exact closed layout equations.

5. Derive helper and entry RunEquals from their actual compilation-success contexts and body laws through envReverse. Preserve all captures. Emit named conversion laws and accepted/raw wrapper equalities with exact original adapters.

6. Generated proof terms use a finite closed combinator/tactic vocabulary: explicit intro/cases/rewrite/congruence/exact/rfl and named registered laws. No model calls, arbitrary proof search, guarantee terms, reference functions, auto-authored Refines or algebraic optimizer. Scoped reduction whitelist, kernel options and recipe hash are registered.

7. Isolated optional replay exports all support definitions/proofs and exact inventories. Exhaustively audit and compare against independently constructed expected types and source-derived definitions. Only then promote CHECKED. Missing or inefficient rules produce unavailable support, never narrowed coverage or weaker equalities.

two_phase_selection_and_replay.base_phase: derive_goal always derives the unchanged standard GoalSpec first. run_base_build performs the current library/contract/base-goal compile+kernel audits with_proof=False. Any base error preserves existing code/severity; INPUT_MUTATION and infrastructure failures are hard and never converted to optional unavailable status.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.optional_phase: Only after successful base admission, try_readable_view creates a separate fresh optional build directory with the exact same hash-bound library/contract inputs and appended enriched goal. Never overwrite/reuse the admitted base goal/module parts. Optional build mutation of any source/accepted/dependency artifact is a hard INPUT_MUTATION. Compare base decl identities, expected statements and proposition hash to unchanged baseline before promotion.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.promotion: CHECKED requires universal entry/helper/adapter/raw equality, complete inventory including unused support, no new axiom/trust, budgets, exact goal/block/input bindings and successful kernel replay. Before authoring, freeze either CHECKED selection with complete expected descriptor or BASE with explicit unavailable status/reasons. Packet usable definitions come only from selected CHECKED goal. All entries/helpers are promoted together.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.fallback: On an optional-only unsupported type/constructor, generation budget, compile/correspondence/inventory rejection, isolated timeout/OOM/tool/output failure, use byte-identical admitted BASE goal and its original packet. Preserve full reported diagnostics and explicit unavailability. Input mutation, failed base audit or shared toolchain/sandbox/library/accepted-module infrastructure is hard; it is not a fallback trigger.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.freeze_before_proof: The supervisor writes candidate support selection sidecar before bridge preparation roots are formed; the proof must target that selected goal. Fixed source_slot vscore-source and proof_slot vscore-proof and exact relation schema stay unchanged. Frozen CHECKED sidecar is a requested identity, not a trusted preview certificate.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.checked_acceptance: load_context loads the exact frozen selection. Acceptance freshly derives/adopts the unchanged base, regenerates exactly CHECKED enrichment and all inventories, compares its full frozen checked descriptor, replays support and compiles the proof against that goal. Any mismatch/failure is blocking; never silently switch to BASE, even when the proof appears not to use support.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.base_acceptance: A frozen BASE selection replays exactly BASE and does not retry optional promotion. A proof naming readable helpers in BASE fails the ordinary candidate compile; no rewriting or stripping proof dependencies. A legacy candidate without selection is strictly BASE and cannot receive implicit enrichment.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.published_replay: Published CHECKED support cannot downgrade on verification/materialization/link/closure. Require identical selected goal, full entry/helper/support inventory and body bindings under fresh replay. Failure becomes existing blocking/infrastructure diagnostics. Resource availability does not change the accepted meaning or selected mode.
two_phase_selection_and_replay.availability_not_lifecycle: CHECKED/UNSUPPORTED/REJECTED/INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE describe this optional support only. They assign no milestone, semantic acceptance, end-to-end result or base capability change.

authoritative_sidecar_and_schema.selection_schema: readable-selection.schema.json; format verislop.vscore-readable-selection/1; schema urn:verislop:schema:vscore-readable-selection:1. Every object has closed named properties. Fixed candidate input slot vscore-readable-selection, role readable_selection, target-node ownership, path support/readable/selection.json. Existing bridge role strings already admit this metadata, but the registered checker must enforce exact uniqueness, role/owner/path/hash and no alternate selection slots.
authoritative_sidecar_and_schema.selection_authority: Supervisor-created before proof candidate packaging; independently read and schema/hash checked during load_context, bound by plan/artifacts/semantic_edge_root. A submitted selection only requests the exact support mode/descriptor; it cannot establish CHECKED. Proof_source remains in the original five inputs; selection is separate context metadata and does not mutate relation or accepted contract.
authoritative_sidecar_and_schema.output_schema: readable-view.schema.json; format verislop.vscore-readable-view/1; schema urn:verislop:schema:vscore-readable-view:1. Authoritative acceptance artifact at readable/manifest.json in semantic edge output. Authoritative only together with current bound semantic certificate/evidence and kernel audit. No manifest self-hash cycle: certificate points to its hash; the manifest lists subsidiary artifact hashes and selection input hash.
authoritative_sidecar_and_schema.semantic_constraints: Beyond schema: unique/sorted inventory by exact source role/id and kernel name; source entry/helper coverage equality; source compiled order provenance; exact selected-mode/status consistency; empty support arrays in BASE; CHECKED support full inventory; exact equality types/definitions; all file refs safe nonredirectable fixed paths; hashes independently computed; no unknown namespace declarations; axioms/dependencies/safety/expression/body audits.
authoritative_sidecar_and_schema.schema_registration: Future schemas.py IDS, verifiers.py VSCORE3_SCHEMAS/CHECKER/BACKEND source inventories must include new schema files, renderer, recipe/catalog and support/exporter changes. Certificate/implementation-IR/build/mechanical-result closed schemas require explicit optional readable_support extension; never inject undeclared JSON fields or bypass validation.
authoritative_sidecar_and_schema.legacy: Existing 0.3 certificate format can gain a schema-defined optional readable_support field. Absent field means only BASE/no support. New selected candidates require the field. Current historical artifacts are not rewritten; new registered source/schema hashes form new qualifications.

exhaustive_support_audit.complete_inventory: Compare every goal declaration not present in admitted base, every declaration in the two reserved readable namespaces, every compiler-generated declaration/auxiliary descended from support, and every new generic support-library declaration. Match exact source-derived expected name/kind inventory. No unused declaration is exempt; extra hidden declaration is rejection.
exhaustive_support_audit.allowed_kinds: Source-generated support is only safe definitions/theorems, with exact level parameter list (empty for generated monomorphic source decls). Reject new opaque/axiom/unsafe/partial/extern/implemented_by/inductive/constructor/recursor, unregistered universe polymorphism, unresolved constants and skipped unsafe auxiliaries in support. Universal generic support lemmas may have registered levels and definition/theorem kinds, all audited.
exhaustive_support_audit.full_identity: For every support definition and theorem export exact kernel-replayed type AND body, declaration kind, safety, universe parameters/instantiations, type/body constants, transitive dependency closure, exact axioms and unresolved names. Hash canonical type and body separately and full identity including proof body. exprjson.decl_hash remains unchanged for base theorem identity; it is insufficient for this audit.
exhaustive_support_audit.required_exporter_extension: VeriSlopKernel currently omits theorem body. Add optional exact support-declaration-name request (closed, staged-module names only) to export theorem expressions or kernel-produced canonical proof-body digests plus full dependency records. Prefer full body expression export under numeric view-only budgets so deterministic body auditing is possible. Existing root import/replay still replays ALL declarations. Missing/omitted/export-error support body is not CHECKED.
exhaustive_support_audit.proof_audit: Expected theorem TYPE is constructed independently from exact Env/source/adapter interface, never accepted from generated text. Generated proof body must typecheck by kernel and reproduce deterministic generator source/body hashes. Different theorem body with equivalent type requires new frozen support descriptor; no type-only substitution.
exhaustive_support_audit.axioms: Freeze the admitted-base permitted foundational/dependency axiom baseline under the unchanged policy; exhaustively walk every support declaration including unused. Its transitive axioms must be allowed AND a subset of that frozen baseline, with no newly declared axiom. Reject sorryAx, native_decide, added classical/choice dependency not in baseline, unresolved walks or policy changes. Prefer pointwise congruences without funext/choice; new logical assumptions are never a remedy.
exhaustive_support_audit.base_preservation: All original goal declaration type/body/kind/safety/level identities, statement_mismatches results, transfer accepted-theorem dependencies, source reexport, Refines inventory, source-only requiredness and proposition hash must match base after enrichment. Additional proof-module uses cannot alter a previously compiled goal.

numeric_view_only_budgets.accounting: Count raw source AST/type fields, each generated IR/definition/proof node and traversal step before emission; no helper graph expansion. Byte budgets apply UTF-8 artifacts and canonical JSON exports, including diagnostic capture. Exceeding a bound yields explicit optional unavailable reason before authoring; never changes base source/compiler/runtime limits. Manifest/output schemas bind exact budget set/hash. No model/inference timer is introduced. Optional Lean compile/kernel use existing frozen build_timeout_seconds/kernel_timeout_seconds/memory_mb/isolation policy and retain its hash; existing execution limits are not relaxed.
numeric_view_only_budgets.output_overflow: Capture full compile/kernel streams up to explicit limits. Overflow means OUTPUT_BUDGET or DIAGNOSTIC_OUTPUT_BUDGET, complete=false, durable retained prefix and overflow metadata, and no CHECKED promotion. Never truncate a stream and claim complete error coverage. Preserve every error actually reported/captured with a compact row per error and fixed-path full artifact refs; long lists can be paged losslessly.
numeric_view_only_budgets.oom_classification: Label OOM only with retained resource/exit evidence; an unexplained process exit is TOOL_FAILURE. Current CompileResult/raw_stderr tail is insufficient for full retention/resource classification; future optional wrapper/leanbridge result extension must retain returncode/resource metadata and bounded full streams.

integration_with_current_apis.change: Keep base GoalSpec/text/expected unchanged; add pure render_readable_source/typed IR and append_enrichment after entire base bytes. Provide independently constructed expected support expressions and exact compiled inventory.

Preview first admits BASE, optionally qualifies isolated enrichment, freezes selected support before any proof compile, returns original info plus readable packet/selection/artifact refs. candidate_files preserves five fixed source/model/profile/relation/proof slots and adds only exact selection and bound diagnostic metadata slots. Never consume author-supplied executable readable code.

Existing candidate slot assembly hashes selection metadata and declared diagnostic files; enforce fixed readable slot ownership/uniqueness at checker load. semantic_edge_root therefore covers selected mode before acceptance. No new required semantic claim or trust premise.

Add explicit separate selection metadata to context. derive_goal derives BASE. Split run_base_build, try_readable_view and replay_selected_build; current callers must choose selected replay deliberately, preserving with_proof=False/True. Never catch a base EdgeFailure as optional failure.

Keep original audit then add exhaustive support audit/body export and base identity comparisons. Build carries readonly selected-spec/support descriptor/artifact bytes. Add readable_support to the registered closed deterministic observation set; both A/B compare full descriptor and every subsidiary artifact digest, even unused support.

For selected candidates add schema-defined readable_support {version:1,mode,status,selection:{slot_id,sha256},manifest:{path:readable/manifest.json,sha256},support_inventory_hash,selected_goal_hash}. Derive all fields from current checked build/context, not submitted metadata. outputs publishes manifest, source block, standalone source, typed IR, correspondence, full exports/audits/diagnostics and selected goal. accepted_modules remains exact goal/proof parts; support is embedded in the goal. Include analogous optional support descriptor in implementation-ir while keeping exact source reification body intact.

Evidence result includes full readable_support descriptor/hash; certificate descriptor already covers every non-evidence field. _check_descriptor validates new schema/sidecar/input refs, all readable files/inventory/body digests, selected mode and exact artifact set, and both closed build observations. Bind metadata without rebuild, never claim fresh execution from stored bodies.

No existing verify_accepted function is invented. Extend verify_published(rebuild=False) structural/hash checks through _check_descriptor and _evidence_result; rebuild=True freshly replay_selected_build twice and compare all support files/manifest/certificate descriptor. prepare.verify_preparation continues routing here. A stored CHECKED support failing replay is blocking and cannot fallback.

Both proof-free run_build call sites must use frozen selection replay; CHECKED mode audits same support even with_proof=False. Original source/program/adapter/link inventory and proof_checked:false meaning remain intact; compare unchanged base-derived materialization fields. Never permit stale selected goal to pass via BASE build.

Bridge directory input freeze already includes the selection and diagnostics. _clean_build regenerates selected support from source with freshly replayed accepted contract; no preview/stored .olean reuse. Add readable_support to COMPARISON_SLOTS and closed mechanical-result schema; outputs records manifest/artifact/inventory/body digests. Compare/support retain all fresh readable artifacts in builds/A|B/semantic/, alongside existing full module parts and certificate. validate_execution requires exact new output key set and every corresponding artifact; CHECKED replay failure stays blocking/infrastructure.

Narrow theorem-body export and lossless bounded optional diagnostics/resource results are required; register/hash them, renderer/recipe, schemas and any generic support Lean module. New library modules only through explicit library_sources/VSCore3 root order and complete module inventory; no new undeclared imports or trust.

INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: bounded stdout/stderr/kernel output overflow preventing complete audit

hard_always: Any INPUT_MUTATION of source/selection/accepted input or immutable base/dependency artifacts
base parse/typing/adapter/transfer/kernel failures with original semantics
base or shared infrastructure/verifier-owned library/toolchain/sandbox/import infrastructure failure
any CHECKED frozen acceptance/replay failure; never downgrade
unavailable_and_hard_failures.reason_records: Closed reason codes plus stage/source-node location/current binding; all missing coverage reasons; per-error compact rows and durable bound diagnostic artifact inventory. Timeout/OOM/overflow explicitly distinguish reported-error completeness and no success assertions.

normalization_prettyprint_alternative.input: Exact declaration expressions obtained from the current replayed compiler-generated goal/module, under the same source/profile/toolchain bindings. Stored source_fn expressions are not assumed to already be normal or readable merely because elaboration used with_unfolding_all.
normalization_prettyprint_alternative.needed_phase: A pinned Lean-side controlled reduction/quotation phase specializing only compileProgram/findEntry/closed shape checks/casts/environment plumbing with symbolic runtime arguments. Preserve List.map/foldl/Nat.rec and scalar operations as named functions; preserve helper and let sharing.
additional_gates: Hash and register the normalizer and reduction whitelist
Retain exact original and transformed Lean expressions with expected types
Kernel-check universal equality to the unchanged source_fn/entry.run, not just untrusted normalizer isDefEq output
Round-trip pretty output through Lean elaboration and compare the expected expression/type, then replay
Bind all transformation and prettyprinting artifacts independently from the base proposition hash
risks: Broad reduction exposes recursor/equality/typeclass internals and is unreadable
Compiled helper closure expansion can become exponential
Capture substitution duplicates expressions or loses useful let sharing
Symbolic List/Option/record adapter inverses may need proved simplification rather than computation
Implicit arguments, universes, coercions, projections and name hygiene can change prettyprinted elaboration
Runtime primitives must not be evaluated or algebraically optimized while claiming a source-only structural view

Exact expression normalizer may later provide a diagnostic reference, with independent spec/roundtrip/kernel equality/budgets and no shared qualification claim.
